extra.summary: The Citi M1 Credit Card is best for M1 customers who want to earn rebates on their telco bills and enjoy discounts on accessories. You'll get up to 2.7% rebate on M1 bills and purchases at M1 Shops, plus 4.7% on entertainment, capped at S$60 monthly. While rebates don't expire, the card's 0.3% cashback on general spending is low compared to other cashback cards.
badges: Earn Rebates at M1 | FASTER FULFILMENT

our_takes.our-take: The Citi M1 Credit Card is best for M1 customers who want to earn rebates on their telco bills and enjoy discounts on accessories. You'll get up to 2.7% rebate on M1 bills and purchases at M1 Shops, plus 4.7% on entertainment, capped at S$60 monthly. While rebates don't expire, the card's 0.3% cashback on general spending is low compared to other cashback cards. Consider if the M1-specific perks outweigh the limited rewards on other purchases and hefty fees for foreign transactions and cash advances.
our_takes.good-for:
M1 customers seeking rebates on their monthly telco bills and eligible entertainment purchases.
Singaporeans who want to earn rebates on retail transactions and M1 shop purchases using a rewards card.
Individuals aiming to convert rebates into KrisFlyer miles for travel, maximizing lifestyle category spending.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fees of $196.20 can negate rewards; evaluate if your spending justifies the cost.
Foreign transaction fees of 3.25% apply, increasing costs when you spend overseas or online.
Cash advance fees are high at 8% or $15, so avoid using this card for cash withdrawals.
